question: Does a genuine (non-oracle) state-conditioned reconstruction adapter that critiques/reconstructs the retrieved template via structural analysis of (intent, observation-derived state from real DOM/AX tree at 1280x720, retrieved_template) - without ground-truth alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/header_key/body_field/auth_scope signals and without hardcoded confidence - generalize beyond synthetic URL aliasing POC (30/30 rule-based synthetic SURVIVES) to live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld aliasing and to orthogonal alias families (header-based ApiKey/X-Reset-Token, body JSON field, auth permission) at BrowserGym 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees: alias-OOD correct_resolution >=0.50 (binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10, McNemar p<0.05 vs exact matcher), false_accept <=0.15 (>=0.15 below verbatim replay, p<0.05), exact-match >=0.90, no-applicable UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 with ECE <=0.15, and report training cost/stability and verification-boundary economics vs rule-based proxy and vs RAG baseline?
hypothesis: A genuine lightweight state-conditioned reconstruction adapter that critiques the retrieved mechanism's template against current intent and observation-derived state via structural analysis (parse intent verb+resource, score each candidate template's structural match to observed state - slot count, path segments, query-key/header-key/body-field presence, prefix structure, AX-tree derived URL/header/body signals - select or rewrite best template then _bind) with calibrated confidence derived from normalized structural match score (softmax temp 0.15 + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN when max_score <0.80, not hardcoded 0.95/0.05) will generalize beyond the synthetic URL-only POC to orthogonal alias families and to live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld. Concretely: on alias-OOD stratum comprising 30 synthetic orthogonal tasks (10 header ApiKey/X-Reset-Token +10 body JSON field +10 auth permission, each family 7 standard +3 held-out variations requiring segment/key analysis) plus up to 40 live BrowserGym tasks (20 WebShop +20 ALFWorld sampled offline via BrowserGym 0.14.3 at 1280x720 with CDP AX tree; if live unavailable bound claim to synthetic orthogonal), the genuine adapter will achieve alias-OOD correct_resolution >=0.50 with one-sided binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 null and McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (expected 0/30), false_accept <=0.15 and >=0.15 below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY with McNemar p<0.05, while preserving exact-match stratum correct >=0.90 and no-applicable stratum UNKNOWN precision >=0.85 with ECE <=0.15 over 5 bins using derived confidence. A learned GRPO/System-One variant trained only on synthetic alias families (not on held-out variations nor on live tasks) to critique/reconstruct from (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template) with model-derived calibrated confidence will match the rule-based proxy within 0.10 absolute on alias-OOD correct and within 0.05 on ECE, with reported training cost/stability (wall-clock, tokens/calls, variance across 3 seeds) and verification-boundary economics (retrieval+reconstruction+verification cost per task vs false_accept tradeoff) vs RAG baseline.
falsifier: Hypothesis FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if any of: (F1) alias-OOD correct_resolution of genuine reconstruction (rule proxy or pooled) NOT significantly above exact-matcher (one-sided binomial vs 0.10 p>=0.05 or McNemar vs B-EXACT-MATCH p>=0.05, or absolute correct <0.40) on synthetic orthogonal 30 with controls passing; (F2) reconstruction false_accept on alias-OOD >0.25 or not >=0.15 below verbatim replay (paired McNemar p>=0.05); (F3) exact-match stratum correct_resolution <0.85 (reconstruction breaks non-aliased case); (F4) no-applicable stratum UNKNOWN precision <0.70 or ECE >0.25 (calibration failure). SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires all S1-S4 gates plus not dominated by retrieval (>0.10 below best RAG verbatim) and controls PASS. Live-browser stratum is confirmatory when N_live>=20 with same thresholds; if N_live<20 or >50% BrowserGym tasks fail to load/truncate, live result is exploratory and SURVIVES is bounded to synthetic orthogonal only with disclosure, not MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Learned variant falsified if it underperforms rule proxy by >0.15 absolute correct or ECE exceeds rule by >0.10 or training instability CV>0.5 across seeds. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC/NC fail, oracle leak detected (access to alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope or hardcoded constant confidence), or alias-OOD N<24, or >20% harness errors.
baselines: B-EXACT-MATCH (current SPIDER kernel): SpiderKernel.resolve with L97 exact intent equality, min_confidence 0.8, candidates sorted by confidence. Prior 0/30 alias-OOD. ID B-EXACT-MATCH.

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY: Retrieve top-1 mechanism by exact intent equality scan in registry order; replay stored action_template verbatim via _bind without critique/rewriting. Aborts only if required_slots missing. Measures negative-transfer harm. ID B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.
B-RAG-TFIDF: TF-IDF retriever over mechanism intent+template strings; retrieve top-1 then verbatim bind. Tests retrieval alone. Fit only on train registry. ID B-RAG-TFIDF.

B-RAG-EMBED (strong retrieval): Sentence-transformer embedding cosine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 or equivalent offline) retriever over intent+template; top-1 then verbatim bind. If unavailable offline and deterministic, mark unavailable and use B-RAG-TFIDF as strong baseline with disclosure. Never uses ground-truth context signals. ID B-RAG-EMBED.
B-RANDOM: Uniform random among registry mechanisms whose intent matches and required_slots satisfied; else UNKNOWN. Chance-level baseline. ID B-RANDOM.

RECONSTRUCTION-RULE (genuine rule-based proxy): Deterministic structural scorer+rewriter conditioned only on (intent, observation-derived state from real DOM/AX tree or synthetic URL dict, retrieved_template/candidates) that scores slot count, path segments, query/header/body key presence, prefix structure and rewrites path<->query/header/body/auth before _bind; confidence = softmax over candidate scores (temp 0.15) + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80. No hidden_expected access. ID RECONSTRUCTION-RULE.

RECONSTRUCTION-LEARNED (GRPO/System-One): Learned critique-reconstruct adapter trained via GRPO or System-One scoring/budget on synthetic alias families (train split only) to map (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template) -> reconstructed template/bound_action with model-derived calibrated confidence; gated UNKNOWN<0.80. No access to held-out variations or live tasks during training; confidence must vary (not constant). Report training cost/stability vs rule proxy. ID RECONSTRUCTION-LEARNED.
positive_control: PC-EXACT-MATCH: On exact-match stratum (N>=12 tasks where test intent equals registry intent verbatim, same slot names, preconditions match, no aliasing), all applicable methods (B-EXACT-MATCH, RECONSTRUCTION-RULE) must achieve correct_resolution >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 with no crashes. Verifies pipeline resolves when no adaptation required; failure indicates harness/registry bug not hypothesis failure. Control ID: PC-EXACT-MATCH. PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH (exploratory gating): At least 80% of attempted live BrowserGym tasks must load DOM/AX tree at 1280x720 without truncation/timeout (CDP AX tree nodes>10, url and method observed). If <80% healthy, live stratum is exploratory and claim bounds to synthetic orthogonal only. Control ID: PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH.
null_control: NC-NO-APPLICABLE: On no-applicable stratum (N>=12 tasks where test intent is OOD with no covering mechanism) every method must return UNKNOWN (or gated confidence<0.80) with UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10. NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY: Empty registry (N>=6) with any intent returns UNKNOWN 100% (validates kernel does not hallucinate). Failure indicates hallucination/miscalibration, triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Control IDs: NC-NO-APPLICABLE, NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY.
measurement_validity: Registry construction: For each synthetic orthogonal alias-OOD task, registry contains exactly one training mechanism (from alias train template, e.g., header ApiKey vs X-Reset-Token, body apiKey vs key, auth permission read vs admin_scope) + one distractor alias template with equal confidence 0.9 + one exact-match distractor at 0.8, all preconditions={} guards={} to isolate aliasing. Test query uses held-out alias form (e.g., train ApiKey header, test X-Api-Key header). Intent strings for alias-OOD deliberately held equal train==test so exact-matcher failure is due to template aliasing requiring reconstruction, not intent mismatch. No test template appears verbatim in registry (0/30 leakage check). Live BrowserGym tasks: sampled offline via BrowserGym 0.14.3 WebShop/ALFWorld at 1280x720; registry built from training trajectories (intent = goal/observation summary, template = action URL/header/body with slots), test tasks are held-out goal variations with aliased endpoint/field manifestation in observed AX/DOM; no test live template verbatim in registry. Preprocessing fit on TRAIN only.

State representation - genuine non-oracle with BrowserGym 1280x720: context dict provided to resolve/reconstruction contains ONLY observation-derived fields from real browser state: url (observed string at 1280x720), method, url_path, url_query dict, url_segments, headers_observed dict, body_observed (JSON/string if available), ax_tree_snapshot (CDP AX tree text snapshot hash and truncated 2k tokens for parsing, viewport 1280x720), and intent string. It MUST NOT contain ground-truth fixture signals alias_family, query_key, target_prefix, routing_prefix, target_style, path_style, header_key, body_field, auth_scope, expected_template or any field encoding alias answer. Those keys, if needed for scoring, stored separately as hidden_expected metadata not passed to any method. Observation-derived parsing is only allowed structural input besides intent and retrieved_template. Audit will inspect code for reads of forbidden keys and for hardcoded confidence constants. Synthetic orthogonal tasks use minimal derived dict without AX tree to isolate orthogonal alias mechanism; live tasks use full AX-derived dict.

Action representation: Mechanism action_template is string template containing ${slot} parameters in URL path, query param, header value (e.g., ApiKey: ${token} or X-Reset-Token: ${token}), body JSON field, or auth scope. Binding via deterministic kernel _bind plus header/body field substitution. Genuine reconstruction may score each candidate template's structural match to observation-derived state and/or rewrite template structure before _bind conditioned ONLY on (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template/candidates). Rewriter deterministic for RULE variant; learned for LEARNED variant. No hidden_expected access. Confidence must be derived from normalized structural score (softmax over candidates or rewrite confidence) and gated UNKNOWN at <0.80 for ECE; constant 0.95/0.05 hardcoding prohibited and triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Orthogonal alias families and held-out: Synthetic orthogonal 30 tasks = 3 families x10 intents: (a) header-based (ApiKey vs X-Reset-Token vs Authorization Bearer aliasing), (b) body JSON field (apiKey vs key vs api_key vs token), (c) auth permission (scope read vs admin_scope vs permission header). Each family 7 standard prefix/resource combos +3 held-out variations (e.g., novel header X-Api-Key, body field api_token, permission X-Scope) not in rewrite table requiring generalization via key/segment analysis. Report overall 10/family and held-out-9 subset. Live BrowserGym WebShop/ALFWorld: attempt 20+20 tasks with analogous header/body aliasing manifested in real request headers/body or URL aliasing observed in AX/DOM; exploratory if fewer.

Learned GRPO/System-One training protocol: LEARNED adapter trained exclusively on synthetic orthogonal train split (not on held-out-3 variations nor on any live BrowserGym task). Training uses 3 seeds (42,43,44) for stability; report per-seed alias-OOD correct, ECE, variance, wall-clock seconds, LLM calls/tokens if any, and convergence. If offline LLM unavailable, mark LEARNED unavailable and report RULE vs RAG only with disclosure; do not fabricate learned metrics. Confidence for LEARNED must be model-derived and vary across tasks (std>0.05), not constant.

Determinism and seeds: All RNG via numpy.random.RandomState(seed=42) and Python random.seed(42) unless LEARNED seed 42/43/44 for stability reporting; no unseeded calls. BrowserGym Playwright viewport fixed 1280x720, CDP AX tree collection deterministic. Embedding retriever deterministic normalized embeddings. Each task evaluated once per method (paired design); bootstrap resampling for CIs uses block-permutation over tasks (2000 resamples) respecting trajectory grouping if live tasks grouped by site/session.

Holdout and leakage controls: All alias families stratified; train never sees test alias form (verify 0/30 synthetic orthogonal templates appear verbatim in registry; same for live if available). TF-IDF/embedding fit on train registry only. Reconstruction rule/learned model derived from training alias documentation only; held-out forms require structural generalization. Audit checks no method accesses hidden_expected or test-template verbatim except via observation parsing. Registry intent-equality leak verified 0/30. Live tasks split by website (WebShop vs ALFWorld) with no site identity leakage into retriever.

Sample counts (minimum discriminating): Synthetic orthogonal alias-OOD 30 (10 per family incl 3 held-out), exact-match 12, no-applicable 12, empty-registry 6 = 60 synthetic tasks per method x 7 methods (5 baselines +2 reconstructions) = 420 calls. Live BrowserGym: attempt 20 WebShop +20 ALFWorld =40 tasks per method if accessible; exploratory only - if unavailable or >50% truncation/failed loads, mark exploratory and bound confirmatory claim to synthetic orthogonal with disclosure. Overall alias-OOD N>=30 required for confirmatory binomial/McNemar power; live stratum reported separately with Wilson CIs. WebShop/ALFWorld offline tasks use same correct/false_accept/UNKNOWN/ECE definitions; domain shift is exploratory.

Blinding and oracle prohibition: Genuine adapters not tuned on test alias forms; held-out variations excluded from mapping table and from LEARNED training data. Context forbidden keys filtered at harness level before resolve call (derive_state from observed URL/headers/body/AX, not from fixture). Harness exposes reconstruct_resolve(intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates, params) signature.

Verification and metrics: correct_resolution = resolved template binds to URL/header/body that verifies against expected postcondition (hidden_expected_template bound equality including header/body field equality); false_accept = resolved to wrong template or bound incorrectly or should have abstained; UNKNOWN = correctly abstained when no applicable mechanism or gated confidence<0.80. All three sum to 1.0 per stratum. Calibration via ECE over 5 confidence bins (confidence derived from structural/model score) plus abstention precision/recall; Wilson 95% CI for rates; one-sided binomial vs 0.10; McNemar paired for reconstruction vs exact and vs verbatim; bootstrap ECE CI. Training cost/stability and verification-boundary economics reported as exploratory secondary metrics: train wall-clock, tokens/calls, stability std/CV across seeds, retrieval+reconstruction+verification steps per task and amortized cost vs RAG and vs verbatim; but they do not gate SURVIVES (reported with Wilson/bootstrap).

Oracle prohibition auditability: Harness code must expose reconstruct_resolve functions for RULE and LEARNED that take only (intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates, params) where derived_context excludes forbidden keys. Confidence derivation inspectable (score computation visible). Reading task alias_family etc. or constant confidence triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID per parent audit fixes.
decision_rule: All primary thresholds on synthetic orthogonal alias-OOD (N>=30) unless stated; live BrowserGym stratum reported separately. Compute per-method correct_resolution, false_accept, UNKNOWN rates with Wilson 95% CI; paired McNemar for reconstruction vs B-EXACT-MATCH (correct) and vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY (false_accept); one-sided binomial vs 0.10 null; bootstrap block-permutation ECE CI (2000 resamples, trajectory-grouped if live). SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (1) PC-EXACT-MATCH passes (correct >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 for B-EXACT-MATCH and RECONSTRUCTION-RULE on exact-match stratum), (2) NC-NO-APPLICABLE passes (UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10) AND NC-EMPTY 100% UNKNOWN, (3) alias-OOD S1: RECONSTRUCTION-RULE correct >=0.50 AND binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 AND McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (expected 0/30), (4) S2: RECONSTRUCTION-RULE false_accept <=0.15 AND strictly below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY by >=0.15 absolute with McNemar p<0.05 on false_accept, (5) S3: reconstruction exact-match stratum correct >=0.90 (no regression) for both RULE and if LEARNED available also >=0.85, (6) S4: reconstruction no-applicable precision >=0.85 AND ECE <=0.15 (5 bins, derived confidence) for RULE (LEARNED reported separately), (7) not dominated by retrieval: RECONSTRUCTION-RULE correct not >0.10 below best RAG (TFIDF/embed) verbatim correct on same alias-OOD. Live BrowserGym exploratory confirmation (if N_live>=20 and PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH passes): report same S1-S2 thresholds on live; synthesis SURVIVES requires synthetic orthogonal gates plus live alias-OOD correct >=0.50 with binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 and false_accept <=0.15; if live fails but synthetic passes, overall SURVIVES bounded to synthetic orthogonal with disclosure. LEARNED non-inferiority exploratory: report LEARNED correct within 0.10 of RULE and ECE within 0.05; if LEARNED underperforms by >0.15 or ECE exceeds by >0.10, LEARNED falsified but RULE may still SURVIVE. FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but S1 fails (correct <0.40 or not above exact) OR S2 fails (false_accept >0.25 or not below verbatim) OR S3 fails OR S4 fails - bounded to tested genuine adapter class and orthogonal alias families incl held-out and live when measured. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC or NC fails, or audit detects oracle leak (forbidden key access or hardcoded confidence) or constant confidence, or synthetic alias-OOD N<24, or >20% harness errors, or intent-equality registry leakage, or BrowserGym systematic load failure is not re-labeled as falsification but as exploratory bound.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES (synthetic orthogonal + live BrowserGym with calibration): Genuine non-oracle reconstruction/adaptation beyond URL path/query to orthogonal header/body/auth aliasing and live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld provides applicability resolution beyond exact matcher and verbatim replay with calibrated abstention. Product should add reconstruction layer after retrieval (critique-reconstruct conditioned on intent+observation-derived state from DOM/AX at 1280x720+retrieved template, confidence-gated UNKNOWN<0.80) before execution, with verification/repair boundary and freshness guard. Unblocks cross-site parameterized transfer where header/body/auth aliasing is common, addresses MemHarness negative-transfer and freshness/UNKNOWN abstention prior, and justifies sequencing to workflow-compilation (Artic/FlowSearcher) after resolution. Frontier claim C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE advances to EXPERIMENTAL (bounded to genuine reconstruction on tested orthogonal families and live BrowserGym with calibrated UNKNOWN), not PRODUCT_CORE until learned GRPO/System-One stability and end-to-end economics replicate at scale. Report economics: retrieval+reconstruction+verification cost per successful task vs RAG vs verbatim.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED: Genuine state-conditioned structural reconstruction does not beat exact matcher/verbatim on controlled orthogonal aliasing (header/body/auth) or on live BrowserGym, or only by inflating false_accepts/miscalibration (ECE failure), or learned variant fails to match rule proxy. Product must NOT add reconstruction layer as product feature for these families; keep exact-intent matching and require agents to supply exact intents or pre-normalized templates; prioritize explicit alias catalogs, server-side routing normalization, or per-site header/body mapping tables. Frontier mechanism closed for this adapter class and families incl held-out/live; next Frontier attack should test orthogonal basin (artifact-driven workflow compilation, hierarchical DAG synthesis, program-synthesis repair, cache invalidation) rather than tuning reconstruction thresholds. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains HYPOTHESIS (bounded falsification for tested genuine adapter on tested orthogonal families/live, not global falsification of all semantic resolution). Learned GRPO failure indicates training instability or synthetic-to-real gap, not blanket rejection of critique-reconstruct class.
estimated_cost: Low-moderate: 60 synthetic + up to 40 live =100 tasks x7 methods =700 deterministic kernel resolve+bind calls plus TF-IDF/embedding retrieval offline (no paid LLM for RULE arm, <15 min CPU). LEARNED GRPO training adds 1-3h wall-clock if using local small LM (e.g., 7B) or hosted LLM ~200k-500k tokens for critique-reconstruct fine-tune with 3 seeds; report wall-clock/tokens. Live BrowserGym at 1280x720 adds <40 Playwright navigations with CDP AX extraction (<30 min if fixtures local, <5 min per 20 tasks). Total compute <4h on single runner, no large datasets committed, no giant raw data. Offline embedding local CPU. If LLM unavailable, LEARNED arm disclosed as unavailable and cost drops to <30 min.
expected_information_gain: Very high: First valid test of learned (GRPO/System-One) vs rule-based genuine structural reconstruction and first orthogonal-family (header ApiKey/X-Reset-Token, body JSON field, auth permission) plus live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld validation at BrowserGym 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees - directly addresses Director's REOPEN mandate and parent handoff's two dominant unknowns (learnability/training cost/stability and synthetic-to-real gap). Either outcome changes product/architecture decision: positive validates retrieval+reconstruction vs exact matcher for broader aliasing and unblocks cross-site transfer sequencing with calibrated abstention and measured economics; negative falsifies adaptation prior for orthogonal families/live and cleanly parks semantic claim forcing pivot to compilation/synthesis. Strong baselines (exact, verbatim, TFIDF, embed, random) and PC/NC with calibration gates (UNKNOWN precision, ECE) plus header/body/auth non-vacuous isolation and trajectory-grouped permutation ensure result not explained by retrieval strength, hallucination, or vacuous C4 where full==body. Orthogonal to 30+ prior freshness/PMI/TV loops and to narrow URL-only POC (30/30 synthetic), satisfying frontier charter to leave solution basin. Reports training cost/stability and verification-boundary economics vs rule proxy and RAG for product decision.
